Loc.Import.Title: Instrument data import
Loc.Import.Subtitle: Choose a parser by instrument manufacturer/format; multiple files default to one line per file.
Loc.Import.Note: Supports Leica DNA (GSI/MDT), GeoMax ZDL (MDT), Sokkia SDL (CSV), Topcon DL (DAT), Trimble DiNi (DAT), Lev_Net (OUT/MDT), and generic height-difference OUT based on the bundled samples and manuals. Multiple files default to one line per file; original bytes and SHA-256 are retained.

Loc.Report.Title: Reports and result export
Loc.Report.Description: The report follows the professional structure of the legacy Report.doc: project overview, elevation control survey, network adjustment, conclusions, and recommendations. Standards and conclusions are entered by the user for the actual project; the software does not invent acceptance conclusions that cannot be verified from calculated results.
Loc.Report.Section12: 1.2 Natural geography of the survey area
Loc.Report.Section3Hint: Export automatically generates 3.1 Network accuracy assessment, 3.2 Closed-route statistics, 3.3 Known-point results, 3.4 Height-difference observation results, 3.5 Segment mean errors and residuals, and 3.6 Elevation results.
